hints.title: Iterative Multiplication
hints.text: Test increasing repetitions of word, starting from k = 1.

hints.title: Check Substring Containment
hints.text: While the repeated word string word * k is contained in sequence, increment k.

hints.title: Return Previous Valid Count
hints.text: When containment fails, the answer is k minus 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Complex suffix automaton or KMP is unnecessary for small length bounds (n <= 100).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Repeated string containment test runs well within millisecond limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice small input lengths and implement simple linear repetition testing.
